title: When Standing Up for Yourself Turns Into a Fight
summary: Help your teen use one firm line, move toward safety, report observable facts to a named adult, and follow up without turning dignity into a fight for the crowd.
seo_title: Help Your Teen Stand Up Without Fighting
seo_description: A practical parent guide to help teens answer peer provocation with one firm line, a purposeful exit, a factual adult report and a follow-up plan for school.
release_move: Keep adult ownership of safety, school contact and follow-up while the teenager increasingly owns ordinary boundary wording, purposeful movement, factual reporting and repair for any harm they caused.

core_belief_shift.from: Standing up for yourself means staying in the exchange long enough to prove that nobody can make you back down.
core_belief_shift.to: Standing up can mean one clear boundary, purposeful movement toward safety and bringing responsible adults into repeated targeting or danger.

book_relevance.reason: The War Playbook is a restrained optional fit for choosing which conflicts deserve engagement and protecting tomorrow from a reactive decision; this parent guide is complete and stands alone.

next_step.label: Help your teen leave group drama safely
next_step.reason: Use this next when a boundary is not enough and the group itself needs a low-fuel exit.

hero.alt: A father talks calmly with his teenage son in a school sports-hall corridor while an adult coach remains visible nearby.
